messages: ana: Quick thread — compact/timepicker experiment + contextual sampling toggle idea. Posting mocks: https://figma.com/proto/compact-timepicker-mock (ignore broken link) mike: Looks good. Do we lose context when compacting the timepicker? ana: That's the worry. Compact mode hides presets and full-range context; sampling toggle would show 'context-aware sampling' to keep p95 stability lines when zooming. julia: Can we keep quick keyboard affordance? e.g., 't' to open timepicker and arrows to nudge range. sam: Agree. Accessibility: the compact timepicker needs aria-expanded on the trigger and role=dialog for the picker. kevin: Quick copy idea for sampling tooltip: 'Contextual sampling reduces noise by anchoring p95 to recent baseline. Turn on to preserve trend continuity.' Too wordy? ana: Maybe: 'Preserve baseline when sampling (helps p95 stability).' Shorter. mike: UX nit: the sampling toggle is visually similar to the live/paused toggle. Can we change label color or add icon? :thinking: julia: Also add a11y hint: 'Toggle contextual sampling (keeps percentile lines stable when time window is reduced)'. sam: Proposed implementation snippet: ``` ``` kevin: Minor: contrast for the label at 12px is borderline. Need AA at min. ana: For the heatmap, we should introduce a low-contrast grid option for compact mode, and keep p95 sparkline bolded. mike: On rollout: A/B test with 10% traffic for two weeks, metric = percentage of sessions using compact picker + change in p95 alert rate. julia: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus ring, descriptive aria-labels, meaningful tooltip text, and focus trap when picker open. Also ensure ESC closes. ana: QA acceptance: keyboard nav passes, tooltip copy approved, contrast fixes, analytics events: 'timepicker.open','sampling.toggle','heatmap.mode'. designbot: New mock uploaded: https://figma.com/file/12345 (file updated). :eyes: kevin: I'll push a small CSS PR for focus states and label contrast tomorrow. sam: I'll add the aria attrs in the component and add tests. ana: Thanks team — follow-ups: mike to draft A/B plan, julia to finalize microcopy, kevin/sam to land infra. Sync tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup: mike: Ack julia: Ack kevin: Ack sam: Ack
